fields.h1: Build an Accident Report Form Filed From the Scene
fields.hero_description: Build an accident report form that sends each report, with scene photos and witness statements, to the person who handles it.
fields.features_heading: What the Adjuster Needs, Captured at the Scene
fields.features_subheading: Memory fades by the time someone fills in a paper form back at the office. These six pieces collect the facts at the roadside.
fields.feature_1:
Questions that follow the kind of accident

Choose a vehicle crash and the form asks for both plates and the police report number. Choose an injury instead and it asks which body part was hurt and where it was treated.
fields.feature_2:
Photos taken without leaving the form

Photograph the damage and the other vehicle from inside the report. Each photo is saved with the time it was taken, and nobody has to chase pictures by email a week later.
fields.feature_3:
The other driver's card, read into fields

Photograph the other driver's insurance card and license. The form reads the insurer and policy number into the report, and anything it cannot read goes back to the reporter.
fields.feature_4:
Every accident type reaches its owner

Send vehicle crashes to the fleet manager by email and injuries to HR in Slack. A report that mentions a hospital visit also alerts the safety lead the moment it is filed.
fields.feature_5:
Witness statements on the same phone

Hand the phone to a witness to type a statement and sign it. Their contact details and signature stay attached to the report that the adjuster reads when the claim opens.
fields.feature_6:
Code you can move to your own servers

On paid plans, export the full codebase to your GitHub repository when reports need to live inside an existing claims system. Host it anywhere and keep building on it.

fields.usecase_heading: Who Files the Report, and Who Gets It
fields.tab_content_1:
The crash packet reaches Renee before the tow truck

Van 9 was stopped at a red light on Oak Avenue when a pickup hit it from behind. The Brightwater Plumbing driver files from his phone with 4 photos and the pickup's plate and insurer. Any crash involving another vehicle goes to Renee, the fleet manager, by email. She opens the claim before the tow truck arrives.
fields.tab_content_2:
Back strains that need a clinic reach HR the same day

Mattresses are heavy, and housekeepers lift them all shift. At Harborview Hotel, a housekeeper strains her lower back turning one in room 412. Her supervisor files the report with the task and the treatment. Any injury treated beyond first aid posts to the HR channel in Slack the same day, and this one went to a clinic.
fields.tab_content_3:
A fall in the shrub aisle goes on record with a witness

Garden hoses cross the shrub aisle at Greenleaf Garden Center, and a customer catches one with her foot and falls. A cashier who saw it types a short statement and signs on the staff tablet. The report holds 2 photos of the aisle and notes that the customer declined an ambulance. Tom, the owner, has it before closing.
fields.tab_content_4:
After 30 days, an open claim returns to the risk manager

Every accident report at Pinecrest Property Management carries the insurance claim it became. The risk manager sees each claim and how long it has been open. A stairwell fall at Birch Court has been open 41 days. Anything open more than 30 days goes on her follow-up list, and she emails the adjuster from there.

fields.howto_title: How to Create an Accident Report Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to create an accident report form that records the facts at the scene and puts each report in front of its owner.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Start with the accidents you see most
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Ask for what an adjuster asks for
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Make photos part of the report
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Pick who hears about each type
fields.howto_step_1_des: Look back over the last year of accidents, such as van crashes or lifting injuries. Each one becomes a type on the form with its own questions. A plumbing company and a hotel end up with different lists.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Collect when and where it happened, who was hurt and which vehicles were involved. Add a plain account of events in order. Keep fault and blame off the form, because the insurer and the investigation decide those.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Require photos for any vehicle crash or property damage. Add a step for the insurance card from the other car, which the form reads into fields. The reporter corrects anything that came through unclear before submitting.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Decide who receives each kind of accident and how. Crashes might email the fleet manager while injuries post to an HR channel in Slack. Anything with a hospital visit can alert the safety lead too. Name a backup for nights and weekends.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Put the accident types and routing rules into one prompt. Emergent builds the accident report form, the database behind it, and a screen for whoever reviews reports. Ask in plain English when a question needs changing later.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Match each report to its claim
fields.howto_step_6_des: Add fields for the insurance claim number and the date the claim closed. The risk team then sees which reports turned into claims and how long each one has been open. Claims that stall come back to someone by name.
fields.howto_step_7_des: File a test crash from a phone in the parking lot using a made-up insurance card. Check that the email reaches the fleet manager and that the report lands in the table under the right type.

plan.angle: The live top 10 is blank PDFs from a university, a town, a state claims office and a college fleet, two template.net pages, a Pinterest board and one Google Form template. Every one stops at a filled-in sheet and none answers what searchers ask next: who fills it out, how to report in Texas, when to call the insurer. This page answers those questions plainly and shows four operators what happens after submit: a van crash that reaches the fleet manager as a claim packet from the roadside, a housekeeper's back strain that reaches HR the same day, a customer's fall at a garden center with a witness on record, and an insurance claim left open 41 days that comes back to the risk manager.
tab_stories: A Brightwater Plumbing driver whose van 9 is rear-ended at a red light files the report from his phone with four photos, the other driver's plate and insurer, and the police report number, and Renee, the fleet manager, gets the whole packet by email before the tow truck arrives.
A housekeeper at Harborview Hotel strains her back lifting a mattress in room 412, her supervisor files the report, and because she was sent to a clinic the report reaches Omar in HR the same day.

A customer at Greenleaf Garden Center trips over a hose in the shrub aisle, a staff member records a witness and photos of the aisle, and the owner gets the report with a note that the customer declined an ambulance.

Pinecrest Property Management ties every accident report to its insurance claim, and a stairwell fall at Birch Court open 41 days lands on the risk manager's follow-up list because anything past 30 days goes there.

claims_to_source: Texas Transportation Code 550.026: after a collision that injures or kills a person or leaves a vehicle unable to be driven normally and safely, the driver must immediately notify the local police department or sheriff's office
TxDOT no longer keeps Driver's Crash Reports (CR-2); drivers in a crash no officer investigated should keep their copy for their records
A copy of a Texas peace officer's crash report (CR-3) can be bought online from TxDOT and arrives by email
Most auto policies require prompt notice of an accident, and drivers should photograph the other driver's insurance card and license (Texas Department of Insurance)

scope.evidence: H1 'Build an Accident Report Form Filed From the Scene' and hero 'Build an accident report form that sends each report, with scene photos and witness statements, to the person who handles it.' (under 130 chars, primary, leads with Build). How-to description is one sentence under 140 chars: 'Seven steps to create an accident report form that records the facts at the scene and puts each report in front of its owner.'

intent.evidence: AMBER SERP of blank PDFs and templates: the page gives a worked example (FAQ 3), template guidance (FAQ 6, 7), field lists for auto and injury reports (FAQ 4, 8) and a seven-step how-to specific to accident types, photos, routing and claims.

specificity.evidence: Buyer vocabulary throughout: 'police report number', 'the other driver's insurance card', 'treated beyond first aid', 'an open claim returns to the risk manager'.

openers.evidence: Paragraphs open on full sentences: 'Van 9 was stopped at a red light on Oak Avenue', 'Garden hoses cross the shrub aisle', 'Choose a vehicle crash and the form asks for both plates'.

craft.evidence: No blocking craft defect; one missing serial comma and one step that names the wrong date field are recorded as notes.

voice.evidence: Concrete, unglamorous detail: 'room 412', 'Van 9', 'open 41 days', 'File a test crash from a phone in the parking lot using a made-up insurance card.'

truth.evidence: Emergent claims map to claims_used (alerts, ai-extraction, e-signature-capture, code-export with 'On paid plans'); comparison table generated from the library; tab 4 numbers 41 - 30 = 11 agree between copy and image.

distinct.evidence: Near misses are handed to the incident report sibling ('Log near misses on an incident report form instead'); tabs (fleet crash, hotel injury, customer fall, claim follow-up) are this page's own.

faq.evidence: Exactly 10 on-topic questions, none naming a brand or a file format; hub link in item 2; Emergent moat lines in items 6 ('with no response caps') and 10 ('keeps every report in a database you own').

images.evidence: Contact sheet: one hero per tab, readable; 'Email to Renee, fleet manager' with '4 photos attached'; 'Clinic visit, beyond first aid' to #hr-injuries; 'Sent to Tom, owner' with '2 photos of the aisle' and 'Customer declined an ambulance'; 'Claim open 41 days', '11 days past the limit'. All match the tab copy.
